If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, increase late-period forecast by 1.5–2.5% relative to mid-period trend.  
If sentiment is consistently negative (≤-0.33) in the last 3 days, reduce late-period forecast by 1.5–2.5% relative to mid-period trend.  
If sentiment spikes to 1.00 in the last 2 days, shift mid-period forecast upward by 0.5–1.0% and adjust late-period to match.  
If sentiment is mixed (0.00–0.33) in the last 3 days, apply no correction to mid-period but reduce late-period by 0.5–1.0% to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is negative in the last 3 days but true outcome shows strong upward momentum, reverse late-period forecast by 1.0–2.0% to align with sentiment reversal.  
If sentiment is positive in the last 3 days but true outcome shows downward momentum, reduce mid-period forecast by 0.5–1.0% to reflect sentiment divergence.
